instruction.text: Complete the sentence with the missing word.

atoms.a: It is important that a judge is without prejudice.
atoms.b: It is important that a judge is without ((prejudice)).

atoms.a: The cultural heritage of a country is often exhibited in museums and includes music, artifacts, tales and much more.
atoms.b: The cultural ((heritage)) of a country is often exhibited in museums and includes music, artifacts, tales and much more.

atoms.a: In recent years, many laws have been passed to prohibit discrimination based on gender.
atoms.b: In recent years, many laws have been passed to prohibit ((discrimination)) based on gender.

atoms.a: After years of stagnation, the people hoped for a period of prosperity to come.
atoms.b: After years of stagnation, the people hoped for a period of ((prosperity)) to come.

atoms.a: Their homework was to produce a short documentary film on a topic of their choice.
atoms.b: Their homework was to produce a short ((documentary)) film on a topic of their choice.

atoms.a: Penelope gave a credible performance playing the role of the Queen in the school play.
atoms.b: Penelope gave a ((credible)) performance playing the role of the Queen in the school play.

atoms.a: My uncle taught me not to stereotype people based on their looks.
atoms.b: My uncle taught me not to ((stereotype)) people based on their looks.

atoms.a: The students respect their teacher a lot.
atoms.b: The students ((respect)) their teacher a lot.
